title.zh-CN: AI 零基础概率分布
title.en: Probability Distributions for AI Beginners

subtitle.zh-CN: 从样本空间、随机变量和离散分布走到可复现采样与模型概率。
subtitle.en: Move from sample spaces, random variables, and discrete distributions to reproducible sampling and model probabilities.

aiModelConnections.zh-CN: 分类器、语言模型和生成模型都会输出或使用概率分布。
aiModelConnections.en: Classifiers, language models, and generative models output or use probability distributions.

aiModelConnections.zh-CN: 交叉熵、似然、采样和校准都需要先理解分布。
aiModelConnections.en: Cross entropy, likelihood, sampling, and calibration require distribution intuition first.

learningObjectives.zh-CN: 先列出样本空间，再把结果映射为离散随机变量。
learningObjectives.en: List a sample space before mapping outcomes to a discrete random variable.

learningObjectives.zh-CN: 检查概率非负、有限且总和为 1。
learningObjectives.en: Check that probabilities are nonnegative, finite, and sum to 1.

learningObjectives.zh-CN: 区分概率分布、一次样本和经验频率。
learningObjectives.en: Distinguish a probability distribution, one sample, and an empirical frequency.

learningObjectives.zh-CN: 用固定随机种子复现采样，并解释模型概率不是绝对事实。
learningObjectives.en: Reproduce sampling with a fixed random seed and explain why a model probability is not an absolute fact.

description.en: The set of all possible outcomes.

plainExplanation.zh-CN: 先列出可能结果，概率讨论才有对象。
plainExplanation.en: List possible outcomes first so probability has objects to discuss.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: 像给随机实验画出所有出口。
geometricIntuition.en: Like drawing all exits of a random experiment.

numericalExample.zh-CN: 三分类器的样本空间可以是 \{猫,狗,鸟\}。
numericalExample.en: A three-class classifier can have sample space \{cat,dog,bird\}.

modelConnection.zh-CN: 分类模型的输出概率分布定义在类别样本空间上。
modelConnection.en: Classifier probability outputs are defined over a class sample space.

description.zh-CN: 把结果映射成数字的规则。
description.en: A rule mapping outcomes to numbers.

plainExplanation.zh-CN: 随机变量把文字结果变成可计算数字。
plainExplanation.en: A random variable turns named outcomes into computable numbers.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: 像给每种结果贴一个数值标签。
geometricIntuition.en: Like attaching a numeric tag to each outcome.

numericalExample.en: Coin heads can map to 1 and tails to 0.

modelConnection.zh-CN: 模型评估中的正确/错误、类别编号和 reward 都可以看成随机变量。
modelConnection.en: Correctness, class index, and reward in model evaluation can be random variables.

description.zh-CN: 第 i 个结果的概率。

plainExplanation.zh-CN: 分布给每个可能结果分配非负概率，并且总和为 1。
plainExplanation.en: A distribution assigns nonnegative probabilities to possible outcomes, summing to 1.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: 直方图越高，长期出现得越频繁。
geometricIntuition.en: A taller histogram bar means the outcome appears more often in the long run.

numericalExample.en: \([0.7,0.2,0.1]\) is a distribution over three classes.

modelConnection.zh-CN: softmax 输出、采样温度和交叉熵都操作概率分布。
modelConnection.en: Softmax outputs, sampling temperature, and cross entropy operate on distributions.

concepts.codeExample:
import numpy as np

probabilities = np.array([0.30, 0.70], dtype=float)
if probabilities.ndim != 1:
    raise ValueError("probabilities must be one-dimensional")
if not np.isfinite(probabilities).all() or (probabilities < 0).any():
    raise ValueError("probabilities must be finite and non-negative")
if not np.isclose(probabilities.sum(), 1.0):
    raise ValueError("probabilities must sum to one")

rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
samples = rng.choice([0, 1], size=12, p=probabilities)
print("samples =", samples.tolist())
print("empirical_frequency =", round(float(samples.mean()), 3))

description.zh-CN: 已经知道的条件或信息。

plainExplanation.zh-CN: 条件概率是在已知条件成立的样本空间里重新计算比例。
plainExplanation.en: Conditional probability recomputes proportion inside the space where evidence is known.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: 像先筛出“带信号”的样本，再数其中有多少属于目标事件。
geometricIntuition.en: Like filtering examples with a signal, then counting how many belong to the target event.

numericalExample.zh-CN: 1000 封邮件中，带可疑链接的那部分才是计算后验时的新分母。
numericalExample.en: Among 1000 emails, the suspicious-link subset becomes the new denominator for posterior reading.

modelConnection.zh-CN: 验证集切片、分布漂移和公平性分析都依赖“在什么条件下”的概率。
modelConnection.en: Validation slices, distribution shift, and fairness analysis all depend on probability under conditions.

description.zh-CN: 事件成立时看到信号的 likelihood。
description.en: likelihood of evidence if the event is true

plainExplanation.zh-CN: 贝叶斯更新把基准比例和信号强度合在一起。
plainExplanation.en: Bayes update combines base rate and signal strength.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: 像先看班级里近视人数比例，再看“坐最后一排看不清”的信号怎样改变判断。
geometricIntuition.en: Like starting from the class base rate, then updating after evidence such as difficulty seeing from the back row.

numericalExample.zh-CN: 先验 8%、命中率 82%、误报率 12% 时，后验不是 82%，而要重新按信号人数计算。
numericalExample.en: With 8% prior, 82% hit rate, and 12% false alarm rate, the posterior is not 82%; it must be recomputed from evidence counts.

modelConnection.zh-CN: 垃圾邮件过滤、医学检测和异常检测都要避免忽略 base rate。
modelConnection.en: Spam filtering, medical tests, and anomaly detection must avoid ignoring base rate.

plainExplanation.zh-CN: 期望读中心，方差读稳定性。
plainExplanation.en: Expectation reads center; variance reads stability.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: 像看跷跷板的平衡点和球散开的程度。
geometricIntuition.en: Like reading a balance point and how widely balls scatter around it.

numericalExample.zh-CN: 两个分布可以均值相同，但一个集中、一个分散。
numericalExample.en: Two distributions can share a mean while one is concentrated and the other is spread out.

modelConnection.zh-CN: 采样稳定性、噪声判断和生成模型温度都需要中心与波动。
modelConnection.en: Sampling stability, noise checks, and generation temperature all need center and spread.

description.zh-CN: 所预测类别的置信度，即最高类别概率。
description.en: confidence of the predicted class: the largest class probability

description.zh-CN: 真实标签与预测类别一致。
description.en: the true label matches the predicted class

plainExplanation.zh-CN: 校准检查模型说出的概率能不能当作真实频率来信任。
plainExplanation.en: Calibration checks whether model probabilities can be trusted as real frequencies.

geometricIntuition.zh-CN: 像把所有“我有 70% 把握”的样本放在一起，看实际对了多少。
geometricIntuition.en: Like grouping all examples where the model says 70% and checking how many are actually correct.

numericalExample.zh-CN: 若 90% 置信样本只有 60% 正确，模型过度自信。
numericalExample.en: If 90% confidence examples are only 60% correct, the model is overconfident.

modelConnection.zh-CN: 风险控制、医疗分类和推荐排序不能只看 top-1 对错，还要看概率是否可信。
modelConnection.en: Risk control, medical classification, and recommendation ranking need trustworthy probabilities, not only top-1 correctness.

title.zh-CN: 先问：为什么 AI 要学概率？
title.en: First Question: Why Does AI Need Probability?

content.zh-CN:
很多同学第一次听到概率，会想到“猜中没有”。但 AI 更常遇到的问题不是猜一次，而是在不确定的世界里做一连串判断：这张图像像猫还是狗？这封邮件像正常邮件还是垃圾邮件？语言模型下一个 token 应该把多少可能性分给每个词？

所以本章的主线不是背公式，而是学会一种问法：**概率回答的是：在明确的样本空间里，长期会怎样分配结果**。如果你只看到一次结果，就像只看见一颗小球落进一个盒子；如果你重复观察很多次，盒子的高度才会慢慢显出规律。模型输出的概率条也是这样：它不是“真理标签”，而是模型当前把不确定性分到哪些结果上的声明。

请把概率当成 AI 的“不确定性语言”。样本空间告诉我们可能有哪些结果，随机变量把结果变成数字，分布描述长期形状，条件概率告诉我们知道一条信息后样本空间怎样缩小，贝叶斯更新把旧信念改成新信念，校准检查模型说出的概率是否贴近真实频率。
content.en:
Many beginners hear probability and think "did I guess correctly?" AI usually faces a broader problem: making decisions in an uncertain world. Does this image look more like a cat or a dog? Does this email look normal or spam? How much probability should a language model assign to each possible next token?

The main line of this chapter is not memorizing formulas. It is learning a way to ask: **probability answers how outcomes distribute in the long run once the sample space is clear**. One result is like seeing one bead fall into one bin. Repeated observations make the bin heights reveal a pattern. A model's probability bars work similarly: they are not truth itself; they are the model's current distribution of uncertainty over possible outcomes.

Treat probability as AI's language for uncertainty. A sample space names possible outcomes, a random variable turns outcomes into numbers, a distribution describes long-run shape, conditional probability shrinks the space after evidence, Bayes update turns an old belief into a new one, and calibration checks whether model probabilities match real frequencies.

title.zh-CN: 从确定预测切换到不确定结果
title.en: Move from a Deterministic Prediction to an Uncertain Outcome

content.zh-CN:
回归模型在输入和参数固定时给出确定的数值，但真实结果仍可能有误差。接下来改问“是否发生”：即使当前信息相同，下一局是否按时完成仍可能受玩家状态、随机地图和测量噪声影响。房价是连续目标；按时与否是两个结果，这个区别将引出分类模型。

例如模型给出“按时完成的概率为 0.70”，它不是一次试验的真假保证。一次结果只能产生一个样本；需要许多同类案例才能检查 0.70 是否与真实频率接近。下一节再把两个结果写成样本空间，并约定如何用 0/1 表示。
content.en:
A regression model returns a fixed number when inputs and parameters are fixed, yet the observed outcome may differ. Next we ask whether something happens: even with the same current information, finishing a level on time may depend on player state, a random map, and measurement noise. Housing price is a continuous target; on-time versus late gives two outcomes. This distinction leads toward classification.

For example, a model's on-time probability of 0.70 is not a truth guarantee for one trial. One observed result supplies one sample; many comparable cases are needed to check whether 0.70 agrees with observed frequency. The next section names the sample space and defines the 0/1 representation.

title.zh-CN: 第一步：样本空间、事件和随机变量
title.en: Step 1: Sample Space, Event, and Random Variable

content.zh-CN:
概率先要说清楚可能发生什么。沿用上一节的任务，把样本空间写为 \(\Omega=\{\text{按时完成},\text{未按时完成}\}\)。定义随机变量 \(Z\)：按时完成映射为 1，未按时完成映射为 0。随机变量不是“自己随机变化的字母”，而是把结果映射成可计算数字的函数。

事件是样本空间中的一部分；本例关心的事件是“按时完成”，等价于 \(Z=1\)。若 \(P(Z=0)=0.30\)、\(P(Z=1)=0.70\)，两项都非负且总和为 1。0.70 描述模型分配的概率，观察到的 Z 则只能是 0 或 1。

下图继续使用同一个“按时完成”事件 A。沿箭头把结果变为 0/1；不要把概率 0.70 当成某次观察到的 Z。这里的 0/1 是事件指示量，所以平均值有“按时比例”的含义。天气、课程等任意类别编号不能直接照搬这个解释；作为模型输入时仍需单元 2 的类别编码。
content.en:
Probability first names what can happen. Continuing the previous task, write the sample space as \(\Omega=\{\text{on time},\text{not on time}\}\). Define random variable \(Z\): on time maps to 1 and not on time maps to 0. A random variable is not a letter that randomly changes by itself; it maps outcomes to computable values.

An event is part of the sample space; here “on time” is the event \(Z=1\). If \(P(Z=0)=0.30\) and \(P(Z=1)=0.70\), both values are nonnegative and sum to 1. The value 0.70 is the probability assigned by the model, while an observed Z can only be 0 or 1.

The figure keeps the same event A, “finishes on time.” Follow the arrows from outcomes to zero or one; do not confuse probability 0.70 with an observed Z. These zeros and ones are event indicators, so their mean is an on-time proportion. By contrast, arbitrary IDs for weather or subjects do not have that interpretation; model inputs still need the categorical encoding taught in unit 2.

title.zh-CN: 第二步：频率多了，分布形状才出来
title.en: Step 2: Repeated Frequency Reveals Distribution Shape

content.zh-CN:
一次结果可能很偶然，很多次结果会留下形状。**分布回答的是：很多次观察后，结果会留下什么形状**。把彩色小球重复倒进盒子里，某些盒子会越来越高，某些盒子会保持很低。每个盒子的相对高度就是频率；重复次数很多时，频率会更接近概率。

概率分布把每个可能值分配一个概率：

$$
\sum_i p_i=1,\qquad p_i\ge0.
$$

上式描述离散分布。下图沿用下一节的 NumPy 参考输出，把 12 次 0/1 样本与假设概率 0.70 放在同一刻度比较；有限样本的频率不必恰好是 0.70。

**操作与解释：** 下方构造器另用六个分桶展示分布形状，和上图的二元任务不同。重置后为均匀分布、种子 11、300 个样本；在 60、300、900 个样本之间切换，观察实线柱与虚线理论值的偏差。更多样本通常更稳定，但每一步误差不必单调减小。切换二项或离散化的正态模式时，可能值及理论分布也会改变，不能继续拿二元任务的 0.70 作比较。
content.en:
One result can be accidental; many results leave a shape. **A distribution answers: after many observations, what shape do the results leave behind?** Drop colored beads into bins repeatedly. Some bins become tall; others remain short. Each bin's relative height is frequency. After many repeats, frequency often moves closer to probability.

A probability distribution assigns probability to each possible value:

$$
\sum_i p_i=1,\qquad p_i\ge0.
$$

This formula describes a discrete distribution. The figure uses the next section’s NumPy reference output: twelve binary observations compared with assumed probability 0.70 on the same scale. A finite-sample frequency need not be exactly 0.70.

**Operate and explain:** the builder below uses six bins to show distribution shapes, a different task from the binary figure. Reset to uniform, seed 11, and 300 samples. Switch between 60, 300, and 900 samples and compare bars with the dashed theoretical values. More samples usually stabilize frequency, but error need not decrease at every step. Binomial and discretized-normal modes change the possible values and theoretical distribution; do not compare them with the binary task’s 0.70.

title.zh-CN: 用固定随机种子观察经验频率
title.en: Observe Empirical Frequency with a Fixed Random Seed

content.zh-CN:
代码先验证概率向量是一维、有限、非负且总和接近 1，再使用固定随机种子抽取 12 次结果。固定种子不会让随机过程变成确定规律；它只让这次教学演示可以复现。

运行输出中的经验频率可能不是 0.70。样本量小，偶然波动很明显；把试验次数增加到几千，经验频率通常会在 0.70 附近更稳定。这里必须分清三层：\([0.30,0.70]\) 是模型分布，抽到的 0/1 是样本，样本平均值是经验频率。

若概率包含负数、NaN，或总和不是 1，代码应明确失败，而不是偷偷归一化并掩盖上游错误。后续 softmax 会负责把 logits 转成合法分布，但 softmax 输出是否可信仍需数据和校准检查。
content.en:
The code first checks that the probability vector is one-dimensional, finite, nonnegative, and sums to approximately 1. It then draws 12 outcomes with a fixed random seed. A fixed seed does not turn randomness into a deterministic law; it only makes this teaching run reproducible.

The empirical frequency in the output need not equal 0.70. With a small sample, chance variation is visible. With thousands of trials, empirical frequency usually becomes more stable near 0.70. Keep three layers separate: \([0.30,0.70]\) is the model distribution, the drawn zeros and ones are samples, and their mean is an empirical frequency.

If probabilities contain a negative value, NaN, or a sum other than 1, the code should fail clearly instead of silently normalizing and hiding an upstream bug. Later, softmax will turn logits into a valid distribution, but trustworthy probabilities still require data and calibration checks.

title.zh-CN: 第三步：条件概率是在已知信息下重看样本空间
title.en: Step 3: Conditional Probability Rereads the Space Under Evidence

content.zh-CN:
条件概率是在已知信息下重看样本空间。它回答的是：“如果我已经知道一条信息，原来的概率还一样吗？” 公式写作

$$
P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(B)}.
$$

公式要求 \(P(B)>0\)。这里的竖线 \(\mid\) 可以读成“在……已经发生的条件下”。例如原来随机抽一封邮件，垃圾邮件比例可能只有 8%；但如果我们已经看到“含可疑链接”这个信号，样本空间就被筛成“带信号的邮件”，垃圾邮件比例会改变。

**用同一组人数看分母。** 以下是假设模型的期望计数，不是实测数据：10,000 封邮件中 800 封为垃圾邮件（事件 A），9200 封为普通邮件。设垃圾邮件中 82% 带可疑链接（事件 B），普通邮件中 12% 带链接。于是带链接的垃圾邮件有 656 封，普通邮件有 1104 封。

已知 B 后只保留 1760 封带链接邮件，后验为 \(656/(656+1104)\approx37.3\%\)。若把分母换为全部 800 封垃圾邮件，则是 \(656/800=82\%\)，回答的是反方向的 \(P(B\mid A)\)。图中框宽不表示人数，先看标签与计数；实验中的比例条才按后验缩放。

很多 AI 错误来自把条件说漏了。模型在训练集上 90% 准，不等于在新城市、新设备、新人群上仍然 90% 准；因为条件已经变了。读概率时请养成一个习惯：每说一个概率，就补一句“在什么条件下”。
content.en:
Conditional probability asks: "If I already know one piece of evidence, should the old probability stay the same?" The formula is

$$
P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(A\cap B)}{P(B)}.
$$

The formula requires \(P(B)>0\). The vertical bar \(\mid\) reads as "given that." For example, if we randomly pick an email, the spam rate might be only 8%. But if we already know the email contains a suspicious link, the sample space is filtered to emails with that signal, and the spam proportion changes.

**Use counts to compare denominators.** This is a hypothetical model of expected counts, not observed data: among 10,000 emails, 800 are spam (event A) and 9200 are normal. Suppose 82% of spam and 12% of normal mail have a suspicious link (event B). This gives 656 spam signals and 1104 normal-mail signals.

Given B, retain only the 1760 emails with the signal. The posterior is \(656/(656+1104)\approx37.3\%\). With all 800 spam emails as denominator, \(656/800=82\%\) instead answers the reverse question, \(P(B\mid A)\). Box widths in the diagram do not encode counts; read labels and numbers. The lab's proportion bar is scaled to the posterior.

Many AI mistakes come from omitting the condition. A model that is 90% accurate on the training set is not automatically 90% accurate in a new city, on a new device, or for a new population, because the condition changed. Build the habit: whenever you state a probability, add "under what condition?"

title.zh-CN: 第四步：贝叶斯更新把旧信念改成新信念
title.en: Step 4: Bayes Update Turns Old Belief into New Belief

content.zh-CN:
贝叶斯公式看起来像一行符号，其实是一个很朴素的课堂动作：先说原来的基准比例，再看信号在不同情况中多常出现，最后得到已知信号之后的新比例。

$$
P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A)P(A)}{P(B)}.
$$

\(P(A)\) 是先验，表示看到信号前的基准比例；\(P(B\mid A)\) 是 likelihood，表示如果 \(A\) 真的成立，信号 \(B\) 有多常出现；\(P(B)\) 是归一化项，表示总体上看到这个信号的概率；\(P(A\mid B)\) 是后验，表示看到信号后我们应该更新到的新概率。

代入上节的同一组假设：

$$
P(B)=0.08\times0.82+0.92\times0.12=0.176,\qquad
P(A\mid B)=\frac{0.08\times0.82}{0.176}\approx0.3727.
$$

**操作与解释：** 先重置，核对 B 列的 656、1104、1760；只把基准比例调到 1%，保留命中率 82% 和误报率 12%。此时 100 封垃圾邮件中有 82 封带信号，9900 封普通邮件中有 1188 封带信号，后验变为 \(82/1270\approx6.5\%\)。最后重置回看：信号率相同，基准比例不同，后验就不同。图中每根条都只表示“带信号”的新样本空间，实心是 A，斜纹是非 A。

实验的“假设先验 50%”读数为 \(0.82/(0.82+0.12)\approx87.2\%\)。这个简化不是普遍公式，而是把两类看作同样常见；它与本例 8% 先验不符。

注意 base-rate effect：如果垃圾邮件本来很少，即使“可疑链接”对垃圾邮件很敏感，普通邮件中的少量误报也可能很多。贝叶斯更新提醒我们，不要只盯着信号有多强，还要把它放回整体分布里。
content.en:
Bayes' rule looks like a line of symbols, but it is a simple classroom move: start with the base rate, check how often the evidence appears under each case, then compute the new proportion after seeing the evidence.

$$
P(A\mid B)=\frac{P(B\mid A)P(A)}{P(B)}.
$$

\(P(A)\) is the prior, the base rate before evidence. \(P(B\mid A)\) is the likelihood: if \(A\) is true, how often does evidence \(B\) appear? \(P(B)\) is the evidence: how often is this signal seen overall? \(P(A\mid B)\) is the posterior: the updated probability after seeing the evidence.

Substitute the same hypothetical rates from the previous section:

$$
P(B)=0.08\times0.82+0.92\times0.12=0.176,\qquad
P(A\mid B)=\frac{0.08\times0.82}{0.176}\approx0.3727.
$$

**Operate and explain:** reset and check 656, 1104, and 1760 in column B. Change only the base rate to 1%, keeping the hit rate 82% and false-alarm rate 12%. Now 82 of 100 spam emails and 1188 of 9900 normal emails have the signal. The posterior is \(82/1270\approx6.5\%\). Reset to compare: the same signal rates with different priors produce different posteriors. Each diagram bar represents only the signal-bearing population; solid fill is A and hatching is not A.

The lab's “prior were 50%” reading is \(0.82/(0.82+0.12)\approx87.2\%\). This shortcut assumes equally common classes; it does not apply to the 8% prior here.

Watch the base-rate effect: if spam is rare, even a signal that catches spam well may still include many false alarms from normal email. Bayes update reminds us not to stare only at signal strength; put the signal back into the whole distribution.

title.zh-CN: 第五步：期望读中心，方差读波动
title.en: Step 5: Expectation Reads Center, Variance Reads Spread

content.zh-CN:
分布不仅告诉我们哪些结果可能出现，还告诉我们中心和波动。期望值是长期平均：

$$
\mathbb{E}[X]=\sum_i x_i p_i.
$$

方差衡量结果围绕平均值摆动多大：

$$
\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb{E}[(X-\mathbb{E}[X])^2].
$$

下图给出两份可手算的假设分布：X 等概率取 1 或 3，以及等概率取 0 或 4。两者的期望都是 2，方差分别是 \(0.5(1-2)^2+0.5(3-2)^2=1\) 和 \(0.5(0-2)^2+0.5(4-2)^2=4\)。先找到共同的均值虚线，再比较圆点到它的距离。

方差描述这个随机变量的波动，不直接证明模型预测准不准。评价模型仍要指定目标、误差指标和同一份评估数据。若 X 有物理单位，均值沿用该单位，方差使用单位的平方。
content.en:
A distribution tells not only which outcomes can appear, but also where the center is and how much spread exists. Expected value is the long-run average:

$$
\mathbb{E}[X]=\sum_i x_i p_i.
$$

Variance measures how much outcomes move around the average:

$$
\operatorname{Var}(X)=\mathbb{E}[(X-\mathbb{E}[X])^2].
$$

The figure supplies two hand-checkable hypothetical distributions: X is equally likely to be 1 or 3, versus equally likely to be 0 or 4. Both have expectation 2. Their variances are \(0.5(1-2)^2+0.5(3-2)^2=1\) and \(0.5(0-2)^2+0.5(4-2)^2=4\). Find the shared mean line, then compare the distances of the dots from it.

Variance describes this random variable’s spread; it does not by itself establish prediction accuracy. Model evaluation still requires a target, error metric, and the same evaluation data. If X has physical units, the mean retains those units and variance uses squared units.

title.zh-CN: 第六步：模型概率条也需要校准
title.en: Step 6: Model Probability Bars Need Calibration

content.zh-CN:
分类器最后通常不会只输出一个词，而是输出一排概率。例如 \([0.7,0.2,0.1]\) 表示模型把 70% 的信心放在第一类，20% 放在第二类，10% 放在第三类。它们必须非负，并且总和为 1。

最高概率的类别是模型当前最倾向的答案，但概率高不等于永远可靠。校准要检查“模型说 70% 的样本，在真实世界里是不是大约 70% 正确”。如果模型经常把 90% 说成 60% 的真实正确率，它不是更聪明，而是过度自信。

**读图步骤：** 下图只比较一组假设的有标签记录：10 条预测都说“90% 把握按时完成”，其中 6 条实际按时。先读横轴平均置信度 0.90，再读纵轴实际正确率 6/10=0.60，最后与虚线 y=x 比较。横纵轴都从 0 到 1，点在虚线下方说明这组预测过度自信。它不是单条样本的“真实概率”，也不是一份真实模型评估报告。

读概率条时分清三个问题：概率是否非负且总和为 1；有真实标签时，预测类别是否正确；把许多同置信度记录放在一起，预测把握是否接近实际正确频率。校准需要足够的独立评估样本和清晰的分组协议，不能由一张十条记录的示意图下总体结论。
content.en:
A classifier usually does not output only one word. It outputs a row of probabilities. For example, \([0.7,0.2,0.1]\) means the model places 70% confidence on the first class, 20% on the second, and 10% on the third. The values must be nonnegative and sum to 1.

The largest probability gives the model's current favorite answer, but high probability does not mean permanent reliability. Calibration checks whether examples predicted at 70% confidence are correct about 70% of the time in reality. If a model often says 90% while real accuracy is 60%, it is not wiser; it is overconfident.

**Read the figure:** this is one hypothetical labelled group. Ten predictions all say “90% confident of finishing on time”; six actually finish on time. Read x as mean confidence 0.90, y as observed accuracy 6/10=0.60, then compare with dashed line y=x. Both axes span 0 to 1. A point below the diagonal shows overconfidence in this group. It is neither one example’s “true probability” nor a real model evaluation report.

Separate three questions: are the probabilities nonnegative and summing to 1; when the true label is available, is the predicted class correct; and over many records with similar confidence, does stated confidence match observed accuracy? Calibration needs enough independent evaluation examples and a clear grouping protocol. Ten illustrative records do not justify a population-wide conclusion.

title.zh-CN: 第七步：概率怎样变成 loss
title.en: Step 7: How Probability Becomes Loss

content.zh-CN:
训练分类器时，我们希望模型把更多概率放在真实类别上。如果真实类别的概率是 \(q\)，交叉熵在 one-hot 标签下就是

$$
-\log q.
$$

当 \(q=0.8\) 时，损失约为 0.223；当 \(q=0.05\) 时，损失约为 2.996。概率放错地方时惩罚会迅速变大，这就是分类模型和语言模型训练中交叉熵常见的原因。语言模型预测下一个 token，本质上也是在词表这个巨大样本空间上输出概率分布。

**从图到计算：** 下图用三个类别 C0/C1/C2 的分数 z=[1.5,0.3,-0.8]，在温度 1 下计算 \(p_i=e^{z_i}/\sum_j e^{z_j}\)。三个条的长度严格等于相应概率。真实标签设为 C2，框住的是模型分给 C2 的概率 q；用未舍入的 q 取自然对数得到损失。先按下方表格核对概率，再核对 −ln(q)。

这只是“模型概率可以接受数值评价”的预览。后续先读逻辑回归，再到[分类损失](/learn/loss-functions/classification-losses?route=core-learning-path)主讲 BCE、似然与负对数。本节不要求推导参数更新。
content.en:
When training a classifier, we want the model to place more probability on the true class. If the true class has probability \(q\), cross entropy with a one-hot target is

$$
-\log q.
$$

When \(q=0.8\), the loss is about 0.223. When \(q=0.05\), the loss is about 2.996. The penalty grows quickly when probability is placed in the wrong location. This is why cross entropy is common in classifier and language-model training. A language model predicting the next token is also outputting a probability distribution over a huge vocabulary sample space.

**From figure to calculation:** for classes C0/C1/C2, the figure uses scores z=[1.5,0.3,-0.8] and temperature 1 to compute \(p_i=e^{z_i}/\sum_j e^{z_j}\). Every bar length equals its probability. The true label is C2; the outline marks the model probability q assigned to C2. Take the natural logarithm of the unrounded q for the loss. Check the probability table first, then −ln(q).

This previews how model probabilities can be evaluated numerically. Continue to logistic regression before the [classification-loss lesson](/learn/loss-functions/classification-losses?route=core-learning-path), which owns BCE, likelihood, and negative logarithms. Parameter-update derivation is not required here.

title.zh-CN: 本章小结与后续路线
title.en: Summary and the Route Ahead

content.zh-CN:
本章需要带走四件事：样本空间列出可能结果；随机变量把结果映射为数；概率分布为可能值分配非负且总和为 1 的权重；经验频率来自重复样本，不等于单次结果。

条件概率、贝叶斯更新、期望与方差、softmax、交叉熵和校准在本页提供了应用预览，但它们会在后续概率专题中分别展开。此处只要求能检查一个离散分布、解释一次采样与长期频率的区别，并说明模型概率为什么不是绝对事实。
content.en:
Carry four ideas forward: a sample space lists possible outcomes; a random variable maps outcomes to values; a probability distribution assigns nonnegative mass that sums to 1; and empirical frequency comes from repeated samples rather than one result.

Conditional probability, Bayes updates, expectation and variance, softmax, cross entropy, and calibration appear here as application previews and are expanded later in the probability route. At this point, the learner should be able to validate one discrete distribution, separate a sample from long-run frequency, and explain why a model probability is not an absolute fact.

prompt.zh-CN: 样本空间回答什么问题？
prompt.en: What question does a sample space answer?

label.en: How many layers the model has.

explanation.zh-CN: 概率必须先知道结果集合，才能给结果分配概率。
explanation.en: Probability must know the outcome set before assigning probabilities.

prompt.zh-CN: 为什么不能用一次结果判断整个分布？
prompt.en: Why can one result not determine the whole distribution?

label.zh-CN: 一次结果只是一个样本，可能很偶然。
label.en: One outcome is just one sample and may be accidental.

label.zh-CN: 因为概率分布不允许重复试验。

explanation.zh-CN: 分布描述长期频率形状，需要多次观察。
explanation.en: A distribution describes long-run frequency shape and needs repeated observation.

prompt.en: A classifier output \([0.7,0.2,0.1]\) is closest to what?

label.zh-CN: 类别样本空间上的概率分布。
label.en: A probability distribution over the class sample space.

explanation.zh-CN: 非负且总和为 1 的概率条表示模型的不确定性分配。
explanation.en: Nonnegative probability bars summing to 1 represent how the model distributes uncertainty.

statement.zh-CN: 不用列出可能结果也能严谨谈概率。
statement.en: We can discuss probability rigorously without listing possible outcomes.

correction.zh-CN: 样本空间定义了概率要分配到哪些结果上。
correction.en: The sample space defines which outcomes receive probability.

example.zh-CN: 三分类和二分类的概率条长度不同，因为样本空间不同。
example.en: A three-class and two-class probability bar have different lengths because their sample spaces differ.

statement.zh-CN: 看到一次结果，就知道整个分布。
statement.en: Seeing one outcome reveals the whole distribution.

correction.zh-CN: 一次结果只是样本；分布要看重复试验后的形状。
correction.en: One outcome is only a sample; a distribution is read from repeated-trial shape.

example.zh-CN: 一次抽到高分不代表所有样本都高分。
example.en: Drawing one high value does not mean all samples are high.

statement.zh-CN: 条件概率只是把两个事件名字写在一起。
statement.en: Conditional probability only writes two event names together.

correction.zh-CN: 条件会改变分母：只在满足条件的样本里重新计算比例。
correction.en: The condition changes the denominator: recompute the proportion only inside examples satisfying the condition.

example.zh-CN: “随机邮件是垃圾邮件”和“带可疑链接的邮件是垃圾邮件”不是同一个概率。
example.en: "A random email is spam" and "an email with a suspicious link is spam" are not the same probability.

statement.zh-CN: 信号很准，所以后验概率就等于命中率。
statement.en: A strong signal means the posterior equals the hit rate.

correction.zh-CN: 后验还要考虑先验和误报率。忽略 base rate 会夸大罕见事件。
correction.en: Posterior also depends on prior and false alarm rate. Ignoring base rate exaggerates rare events.

example.zh-CN: 疾病很罕见时，即使检测敏感，也要看假阳性会带来多少带信号样本。
example.en: When a disease is rare, even a sensitive test must be read together with false positives.

statement.zh-CN: 均值一样，两个分布就完全一样。
statement.en: If means match, two distributions are identical.

correction.zh-CN: 均值只读中心；方差、偏斜和尾部仍可能不同。
correction.en: Mean reads only center; variance, skew, and tails may still differ.

example.zh-CN: 两条生成策略平均分相同，但一个稳定、一个忽高忽低，体验会不同。
example.en: Two generation strategies can share an average score while one is stable and the other swings wildly.

statement.zh-CN: 最高概率高，模型就一定可靠。
statement.en: A high top probability means the model is certainly reliable.

correction.zh-CN: 概率条还需要校准检查。
correction.en: Probability bars still need calibration checks.

example.zh-CN: 模型说 90% 的样本若实际只有 60% 正确，就是过度自信。
example.en: If examples predicted at 90% are only 60% correct, the model is overconfident.

statement.zh-CN: 准确率高就说明所有概率都可信。
statement.en: High accuracy means every probability is trustworthy.

correction.zh-CN: 准确率和校准是不同问题。概率要和实际频率对齐，才能作为风险数值使用。
correction.en: Accuracy and calibration are different. Probabilities must match observed frequencies before being used as risk values.

example.zh-CN: 一个模型可以 top-1 经常正确，但把 70% 说成 95%。
example.en: A model can often get top-1 right while reporting 95% for cases that behave like 70%.
